purpose: Sticky top navigation: collapsing logo rail, Product/Company dropdowns, five direct links, social icons, mobile sheet.

constraints.note: This section's first-position requirement is enforced directly by compatibility/graph.json's SHELL_BOUNDARIES rule (nodes[0].section must equal section.shell-navbar), not by the generic mustBeFirst/MUST_BE_FIRST check — that check assumes 'immediately after shell-navbar', which does not apply to shell-navbar itself.

motion.reducedMotionFallback: opacity:1; transform:none; transition:none (global prefers-reduced-motion rule, src/index.css:80-86)

nav-810.description: The inline nav link row and desktop right-side controls are hidden below 810px and shown (flex) at 810px; the hamburger menu button and its full-width mobile menu panel do the reverse (shown below 810px, hidden at 810px).
